The diff also shows the barrel (`packages/ui/index.tsx`) now exports `MultiEmail` via `./form/MultiEmailLazy`, which dynamically imports `./form/MultiEmail`. This creates a self-referential dependency chain (MultiEmail -> @calcom/ui barrel -> MultiEmailLazy -> dynamic import MultiEmail). While it may not necessarily break at runtime, it’s a concrete architecture/maintainability issue introduced by the diff and can lead to circular-import pitfalls.
